SELECT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqCnsltntListMapper.selectInqCnsltntList : 오늘의슈퍼바이저 게시글목록*/ AA.INDEX_SN , AA.WORK_YMD , AA.CNSLTNT_ID , AA.EXPERT_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , AA.EXPERT_EML_ADDR_ENCPT FROM AYB130 AA , SCA100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID = BB.INDV_IDNTFC_NO AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL )
AND BB.FLNM LIKE '%' || #{searchData} || '%'
ORDER BY AA.INDEX_SN DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqCnsltntListMapper.insertCnsltnt : 오늘의슈퍼바이저 게시글등록*/ INTO AYB130 ( INDEX_SN /*색인일련번호*/ , WORK_YMD /*근무일자*/ , CNSLTNT_ID /*상담사아이디*/ , EXPERT_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /*전문가휴대전화번호*/ , EXPERT_EML_ADDR_ENCPT /*전문가이메일주소*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록자아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일시*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정자아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일시*/ ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(INDEX_SN),0) +1 FROM AYB130 ) , #{WORK_YMD} , #{CNSLTNT_ID} , #{EXPERT_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT} , #{EXPERT_EML_ADDR_ENCPT} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.couns.constt.chttmng.mapper.InqCnsltntListMapper.deleteCnsltnt : 오늘의슈퍼바이저 게시글삭제*/ AYB130 SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
